text:
devin: FYI customer Polyline reporting intermittent 429s + very high tail latency on Dedicated EU-West pool. Ticket INC-5621. Looks like autoscaler is yo-yoing — scale up then immediately scale down while queue still high. Anyone oncall?
maria: on it, pulling router + autoscaler logs now. what window did they see the 429s?
devin: started ~2026-03-17T02:12Z, peaked over ~6m. sample router log below: ```WARN throttle tenant=polyline queue_len=153 avg_lat=1200ms action=scale_down decision_ts=2026-03-17T02:15:10Z```
alex: scale_down while queue_len>100 is definitely wrong. either metric lag or cooldown too short. what's our scale_down_cooldown for that pool?
jen: also seeing tenant adeng pushing a big nightly batch around same time (large embedding job). noisy neighbor suspected. we have high GC/IO on those GPUs in the same pool.
oncall-bot: incident INC-5621 created and routed to eng-sre oncall. Pager duty alert linked.
maria: repro steps I'm running on staging: 1) reserve a dedicated pool with same autoscaler config 2) run bursty load with this ab command: ```ab -n 2000 -c 80 -s 30 http://staging-dedicated-eu-west.internal/v1/generate``` 3) simultaneously run a heavy batch job to simulate noisy neighbor.
devin: thanks. when you run that, can you also emit the autoscaler decision trace? it's under /var/log/autoscaler/decisions.log (json lines)
alex: quick config idea: increase scale_down_cooldown from 30s -> 90s (or 120s) and require 3 consecutive low-util intervals before scaling down (hysteresis). that prevents flipping for transient drops.
maria: tried 90s in a short staging run — oscillation amplitude dropped, 429s went from ~1.2% -> 0.05%, but cost rose ~8% because we kept extra replicas longer.
devin: customer will push back on cost but SLA matters. support-bot, can we tell Polyline we're testing a targeted cooldown tweak and will monitor?
support-bot: Polyline notified: "We are testing an autoscaler configuration change (cooldown/hysteresis) to stabilize capacity; we will monitor for 1 hour and report results."
jen: operational note: noisy neighbor detection flagged adeng's job at 02:13 with GPU util spike + long kernel times. we should consider tenant isolation by workload label for bursty batch jobs.
alex: short-term mitigation: set min_replicas=2 for Polyline's pool so scale down doesn't go to 0/1 during bursts. mid-term: add queue-based hysteresis and per-tenant burst isolation.
maria: I'm going to push a config change to staging autoscaler: ```autoscaler:
  scale_down_cooldown: 90s
  scale_up_threshold: 0.7
  scale_down_threshold: 0.35
  consecutive_intervals_for_scale_down: 3
  min_replicas: 2  # for polyline pool```
please review before I apply to prod polyline pool.
devin: +1. also add a short-lived routing rule to route adeng batch jobs to a burst pool if present.
jen: adding logs + kernel traces to INC-5621. will attach staging repro steps and cost delta from the trial.
alex: FYI, we should also consider adding a smoothing filter on the queue_len metric (EMA over 30s) so autoscaler reacts to sustained trends rather than spikes.
maria: applying to staging now, will run 30m smoke then notify here. if stable, schedule a 1h prod window and alert support to inform Polyline.
devin: thanks team. keeping this thread as the coordination channel. :eyes: :thumbsup:
